title: spiraea alpina var. altaica
intro: Spiraea alpina var. altaica, commonly known as Alpine Spirea, is a plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family and is native to the mountainous regions of Central Asia. It is used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Spiraea alpina var. altaica include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestive health, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
